notes.title: Pretty Overseer Announcement!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26497215/8c422b04e6535afd55670f6f3b12ccd05035157e.jpg[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2140080/Pretty_Overseer__Dating_Sim/

Hi, we have announced the release of the game in steam, add it to the wishlist!

Pretty Overseer is an animated romantic dating simulator in the anime style. You are a young lieutenant overseeing the correction of magically talented individuals in the closed and isolated complex of the military Academy. Your main task is to maintain order and train recruits.

I hope you enjoy our new game!
